headlines.description: Michael Olise produced a stunning 89th-minute winner as France overcame Belgium 1-0 in their Nations League clash in Brussels.

headlines.description: Roberto Mancini claimed his first win back in charge of Italy with a comfortable 4-1 Nations League victory over Türkiye in Bursa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Italy hit four past Türkiye as Mancini gets first win
